Friends, We are **46 days** from Election Day, and a lot is on the line. This race is a toss-up, which means flipping NY-17 is within reach, but it is not guaranteed. Over the next 46 days, we need all hands on deck knocking doors, making calls, and reaching voters in every corner of the district. Let’s leave everything on the field and win this together. Because our district and our country deserve better. Team Cait

Derek, We’re about to ask you to [**make your first donation of 2026 to the DNC**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260918_9234_fr&refcode2=9234_22930333_h3e_ot&akid=9234%2E22930333%2Eh3e_ot) — but first, we hope you’ll give us a chance to explain why we’re coming to you with this urgency, because you deserve the truth: Here’s what’s happening:

* His administration publicly talks about the possibility of ICE agents in polling places.

clean_body: Peter, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in. Sincerely, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House | Paid for by the NRSC. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. |

name: Jeff Bridges
subject: Five Counties. One Saturday.
body:
Summit, Lake, Park, Chaffee, Fremont. And everywhere we went, we heard about some version of the same problem—Colorado has become really expensive.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/8f13298e8974/get-more-smarter-on-colorados-budget-10378791?e=b48bb2b4f4)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Ww4X_4ZN0dg?e=b48bb2b4f4&c2id=bbe572662fdb5fed2d0855c1bcb00da8)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there,
Last Saturday was a big day on the trail.
I headed into the mountains with Colorado Democratic Party Chair Shad Murib for five stops in five counties: Summit, Lake, Park, Chaffee, and Fremont.
And everywhere we went, we talked about some version of the same problem—Colorado has become really expensive.
Housing. Utility bills. Child care. The basic cost of building a life here.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/14nX0WY7o8i?e=b48bb2b4f4&c2id=bbe572662fdb5fed2d0855c1bcb00da8)
| |
That’s a big part of why I’m running for Treasurer.
The Treasurer manages billions of dollars on behalf of the state. I think we should put more of those Colorado dollars to work here in Colorado.
That means investing in:
* Housing working people can actually afford
* Infrastructure our communities and our economy need
* Renewable energy that lowers utility bills and protects the Colorado we love

Those ideas look a little different in every community.
In the mountains, housing costs make it harder for teachers, nurses, firefighters, and other workers to live anywhere near the people they serve. Growing communities need infrastructure. Families everywhere are trying to figure out how to make the math work at the end of the month.
The Treasurer can’t solve every one of those problems. But when you control billions of dollars in investments, you should ask how every dollar available can help.

Five counties. One Saturday. A lot of miles. And plenty more Colorado still to cover.

Thank you to everyone who welcomed us, asked good questions, and shared what’s happening in your community.
I learn something every time I get out on the road, and I’m looking forward to doing a lot more of it between now and November. I'm actually typing this on I-70 just outside Rifle!
---

subject: How can a $3 million fundraising goal change this race?
body:
We’re entering the final stretch of this campaign and need the financial resources to match our momentum.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)

Peter,
We have an official Texas Ethics Commission fundraising deadline on September 24th, and my team has set an ambitious goal of raising $3 million from online donations by then.
You may be wondering: _How can a $3 million fundraising goal change this race?_ Well, let me explain.
Raising $3 million means entering the final stretch of our campaign with the financial resources to match our incredible grassroots momentum to unseat Greg Abbott.
September 24th marks the end of this critical reporting period — and the totals we report will show the public, the media, and our opponent the true strength of our movement.
**I’m proud of what we’ve built together.** A fight for our public schools, lowering costs, and protection from corporations taking over our resources. And when Greg Abbott sees our momentum, he’ll use the massive $67 million war chest he is sitting on to try to silence us before November.
So raising $3 million from grassroots supporters like you will send a signal across Texas showing that we have the people power to back this campaign to finally elect him out of office.
**[Will you chip in $5 right now to help us reach our $3 million goal before the September 24th TEC deadline?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260918_4_tec._ishL5&refcode=em20260918-2170&amount=5&t=2&akid=2170%2E299639%2E6zuleT)**

Thank you,
Gina

| |
# Caught with her hand in the cookie jar
---
| | | | | | Friend,
Two days ago, [campaign finance reports revealed that **Deb Haaland accepted $87,200 from Oracle America and from executives at Clayco**](https://us.list-manage.com/4215XnRLWPf?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810)**, the company building Project Jupiter.** Several of those were maximum donations of $12,400 each.
Yesterday, she called a press conference to announce that on day one as governor, she would sign an executive order halting new data center projects across New Mexico.
**Two days.** That is the entire distance between cashing those checks and standing at a podium demanding a ban.
[**She got caught with her hand in the cookie jar**](https://us.list-manage.com/MYoxPW_QWEt?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810)**,** and that press conference was damage control.
Here is where I stand, and where I have stood since long before anyone was reading finance reports. I have not accepted a dollar from big data. I have not solicited one. And I am not going to shut the door on an entire industry to get through a news cycle, because a blanket moratorium tells every employer looking at New Mexico that we are closed for business at exactly the moment we should be competing.
I do not support a blank check either. Data centers have to be sited responsibly, with real accountability for water use, for energy impact, and for the communities that live next to them. That is the work. It is harder than a press conference, and it is what I did for twelve years as Mayor of Rio Rancho.
My opponent can afford to change her position whenever the coverage turns. I answer to New Mexicans, and that is exactly how I want it.
So I am asking you directly. **A contribution of $25 puts this story in front of voters who have not seen it yet. $50 keeps our ads running in Albuquerque and Las Cruces through the weekend. $100 helps us reach the undecided voters who will decide this race in November.** You can give right now at [GreggHull.com](https://us.list-manage.com/xacIHsyiNq5?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810).
Every dollar we raise comes from people who want a governor with a record, not a governor with donors to manage.
Thank you for standing with me,
---
|

body:
New FBI Records on Trump Assassination Attempt

[INSIDE JW]

JUDICIAL WATCH UNCOVERS ANTI-CHARLIE KIRK EMAILS AT UTAH UNIVERSITY

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38684&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9zTmdSOUg2clhEWT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=6ea6d6ad7623c422e2f4e0fb93f149b38663ed6f222aaff0e6ef9f9f19903258]

We obtained 133 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38672&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3V0YWgtdmFsbGV5LXVuaXYtY2hhcmxpZS1raXJrLXJlY29yZHMtcHJvZC0zLTIwMjYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=b6454d551e2b3e3c8ca89fe09cfc4dec0ebe721e33994a3da5122863e9343995]
of records from Utah Valley University (UVU) revealing sharply
anti-Charlie Kirk messages from individuals identified as university
faculty or instructors in the weeks following Kirk’s assassination
on the UVU campus.

Charlie Kirk, founder of Turning Point USA, was killed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38673&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2hpdGVob3VzZS5nb3YvcHJlc2lkZW50aWFsLWFjdGlvbnMvMjAyNS8xMC9uYXRpb25hbC1kYXktb2YtcmVtZW1icmFuY2UtZm9yLWNoYXJsaWUta2lyay8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=5db1bad755bf44d15550cfbdc2e625997ce5c944d1b2931983fc1604314f0061]
on September 10, 2025, while kicking off a speaking tour
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38674&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZm94bmV3cy5jb20vdXMvdHVybmluZy1wb2ludC11c2EtY28tZm91bmRlci1jaGFybGllLWtpcmstc2hvdC1raWNrb2ZmLWRheS1hbWVyaWNhbi1jb21lYmFjay10b3VyP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=d4959de8ce9112f1e5db90c37df0f670417b4b38498b529b447b8b3a470e2642]
at college campuses.

We received the records through a Utah Government Records Access and
Management Act (GRAMA) request for emails and text messages concerning
Kirk involving then-UVU President Astrid S. Tuminez.

The records include a September 22 email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38675&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3V0YWgtdmFsbGV5LXVuaXYtY2hhcmxpZS1raXJrLXJlY29yZHMtcHJvZC0zLTIwMjYtcGdzLTQyLTQzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=ebe2256952eb7dd210318c110b67e83dee937d043be25fc2489588c0b9d0c609]
apparently written by a UVU instructor to President Tuminez. The
writer referred to “students we are trying to educate” and
attacked Kirk in stark terms:

> Charlie Kirk appealed to the worst of us. He spoke his prejudices
> openly, not to test free speech, but to shape minds. He targeted
> impressionable youth, feeding on their fears and anxieties....

> The hidden message in his rants was clear: hate is natural, and to
> resist it is to deny who you are. Hate masquerading as justice is
> nothing of the sort. True justice seeks fairness, accountability,
> and protection for all, while hate targets, divides, and
> destroys....

> That is why we must resist any effort to memorialize him or turn him
> into an icon.... Charlie Kirk did not stand for civility,
> compassion, or truth. There was nothing civil about him.

***

> To memorialize him would be a grave mistake.

In a November 4, 2025, email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38676&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3V0YWgtdmFsbGV5LXVuaXYtY2hhcmxpZS1raXJrLXJlY29yZHMtcHJvZC0zLTIwMjYtcGdzLTEyMS0xMjIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=00b46239af45b0134d979966ee110c4a32f896e3701a8599c69d2f58a75e4dbf]
a self-described “faculty member” at UVU writes:

> I’ve had a hard time dealing with the aftermath of the shooting on
> our campus, and in particular, I cannot understand how people could
> support or mourn someone who was so divisive and spewed such
> vituperation in his “debates.” I regret that he was invited to
> UVU at all, and wish you had rethought the decision to allow him a
> forum on our campus.

***

> Also, there has been talk of a memorial to Charlie Kirk that will be
> placed on the UVU campus. The legislature seems determined to make
> it happen, and they have enormous power in Utah. I ask you to resist
> their desire to desecrate our campus with a memorial to such a
> divisive and hateful public figure. Please do not let it happen. It
> does not align with our brand of inclusiveness and welcoming. Should
> a memorial to him be erected on our campus, I fear you will lose
> many faculty members, including myself.

***

> I would not work at a university that supports Charlie Kirk's ideals
> in any way.

The records reveal that just nine days after Kirk was assassinated, a
person whose name is redacted was already proposing a $1 million
fundraising
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38677&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3V0YWgtdmFsbGV5LXVuaXYtY2hhcmxpZS1raXJrLXJlY29yZHMtcHJvZC0zLTIwMjYtcGdzLTE3LTE4Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=9822441d0e79c3a49010d8ef4b97f723b2e524b75e95a92af4550214a178fcad]
effort called “Our Better Selves for a Better America.”

I would like to raise $1 million for this proposal. I took the liberty
of starting a draft. I'd like a very quick turnaround so I can
fundraise quickly. I have one pledge for $100k. I would like to raise
the other $900k quickly.

UVU subsequently established “Our Better Selves for a Better America
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38678&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudXZ1LmVkdS9vdXJiZXR0ZXJzZWx2ZXMvXeKAnT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=02b45ac8edaa272e7a50fbd15a00e97d1fbb9e22dec133177ac19499a10d51a5 as a university-wide
initiative focused on civil dialogue, disagreement, conflict
resolution, and civic responsibility.

The newly released records show that, behind the university’s public
appeals for unity and free expression, some members of the UVU faculty
were expressing a very negative attitude toward Kirk and his
supporters.

Charlie Kirk was assassinated while exercising his right to speak on a
college campus. These records reveal that, even as Utah Valley
University publicly called for free expression and civil discourse,
some faculty members were making hateful and vicious comments about
him, objecting to his invitation to campus, and threatening to leave
if his memory were honored.

We previously obtained records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38206&F=T&&hash=30d634dff06108ef4255ed1116346fd96781e56710beb57c554b2d9f4a0a6fa9]
from Utah Valley University through this same records request
detailing the university’s efforts to immediately pave over the site
where Kirk was murdered.

FBI RECORDS REVEAL THOMAS CROOKS BEHAVIOR BEFORE TRUMP SHOOTING

Thomas Matthew Crooks, who attempted to assassinate Donald Trump at a
July 2024 campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, purchased “a chest
rig and ceramic plates,” and exhibited increasingly unusual
behavior, including talking to himself, pacing at night, staying awake
for extended periods and exhibiting impulsivity issues.

We learned this from 180 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38665&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=6e802ceaab9afcc2cf7808c9e0e82d34cfcc2874b74a9bc4e117edec5274e8df]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38655&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYvXW9mP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=00cc0e281c20dee2d9c82e89b2f15f929d331bc2ce474c77982d6332fde9ac05
heavily redacted Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) records we
received through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit.

We filed our July 2025 FOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=35667&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi10cnVtcHMtYXNzYXNzaW4vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=5a2539e4190081aa5bc9396065d03c4375cbc83dc966f8556af7061e14293249]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38009&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi10cnVtcHMtYXNzYXNzaW4vXWFmdGVyP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=a25363e132f2b36c7a91dcac17c2191e057c096cb2937dd241e7e504517fe004 the
FBI failed to respond to a July 2024 request for records concerning
Crooks and the assassination attempt (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S.
Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=35650&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtY29tcGxhaW50LTAyMjE2Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=66b51d91588c6d63e35bbd303052e5da4229729edc7ee3eedc1799f0dab64517]
(No. 1:25-cv-02216)).

In a July 15, 2024, FD-302 FBI interview report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38656&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYtcGdzLTM5LTQyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=5bf0a13bd83af0827abe21d046988206de5a07ad438bf68f546b70363c882ca6],
an individual whose name is redacted wrote:

> Thomas purchased ammo online, going from website to website until he
> found a site that would sell to him. Thomas recently bought a chest
> rig and ceramic plates. Thomas had recently gotten into rapid action
> range transition shooting where shooters would enter a timed range
> and switch between weapons while moving.

***

> As Thomas became older, he started to get more agitated when
> [Redacted] and [Redacted] asked questions. Thomas talked to himself
> a lot. After community college he would talk to himself more and
> more, moving his hands and speaking to himself. This activity kept
> [Redacted] awake at night as sometimes. Thomas would stay up all
> night dancing in [redacted]. Thomas seemed to have endless energy.

***

> Thomas was never diagnosed with any mental health disorders as a
> child, but did have impulsivity issues.

A July 15, 2024, FBI i
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38685&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYtcGdzLTYtNy9dbnRlcnZpZXc/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=53a45925964567bf6caeefe48f43970bf92e1d1820c66328001e2e7e3a111971
report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38657&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYtcGdzLTYtNy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=85ca7f99ec6afb3bd557b5f721952ef499d9166db256973432eb1f291312156d]
states that Crooks purchased firearms courses from Keystone Shooting
Center online, including a basic carbine course beginning May 25,
2024, a basic handgun course beginning June 13, 2024, and an
intermediate handgun course beginning June 22, 2024. The courses were
purchased using the email address tmcrooks7@gmail.com.

A July 25, 2024, FBI report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38658&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYtcGctMTIzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=41d2b0fdee9da0a3fdd803ef3a06fae92628714e8b7ec402e7f2b8098cb7695c]
states that Crooks was seen with two older men at a firearms store.
Employees of Keystone Armory in Edinboro, PA, contacted the FBI about
Crooks’ May 2024 visit:

> The individual believed to be Crooks was accompanied by a white male
> believed to be around his mid 30s and another older white male with
> a gray beard, potentially ... the individual’s father. The
> individual believed to be Crooks and the two other males can be seen
> wandering throughout the firearms store looking at various firearms.
> The individual believed to be Crooks subsequently purchased 20
> rounds of Red Army 7.62x54R 148 gr FMJ and left shortly thereafter.

> The store provided the FBI with a receipt of ammunition purchase, a
> list of the store’s witnesses of the “person of interest” and

with the pseudonyms
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38642&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly90aGVuZXdhbWVyaWNhbi5jb20vdXMvb2tjL3VuZGVyY292ZXItdGhlLWhvd2UtcmV2ZWxhdGlvbnMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=63064fabfa98a131de78f4497ada5bf60ad81ab4bb627c245e1d46f3c1cf4923]

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38643&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93ZWIuYXJjaGl2ZS5vcmcvd2ViLzIwMjUwNDI0MTE1MjQzL2h0dHBzOi9qb25yb25zb24uc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL3AvdGhlLWRlYXRoLW9mLWNhcm9sLWhvd2U/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=a115feacbb5bf65b750d5e81268880429ee2388157bac19d844ac5fc4b44918e]

clean_body: New FBI Records on Trump Assassination Attempt [INSIDE JW] JUDICIAL WATCH UNCOVERS ANTI-CHARLIE KIRK EMAILS AT UTAH UNIVERSITY [] We obtained 133 pages [] of records from Utah Valley University (UVU) revealing sharply anti-Charlie Kirk messages from individuals identified as university faculty or instructors in the weeks following Kirk’s assassination on the UVU campus. Charlie Kirk, founder of Turning Point USA, was killed [] on September 10, 2025, while kicking off a speaking tour [] at college campuses. We received the records through a Utah Government Records Access and Management Act (GRAMA) request for emails and text messages concerning Kirk involving then-UVU President Astrid S. Tuminez. The records include a September 22 email [] apparently written by a UVU instructor to President Tuminez. The writer referred to “students we are trying to educate” and attacked Kirk in stark terms: Charlie Kirk appealed to the worst of us. He spoke his prejudices openly, not to test free speech, but to shape minds. He targeted impressionable youth, feeding on their fears and anxieties.... The hidden message in his rants was clear: hate is natural, and to resist it is to deny who you are. Hate masquerading as justice is nothing of the sort. True justice seeks fairness, accountability, and protection for all, while hate targets, divides, and destroys.... That is why we must resist any effort to memorialize him or turn him into an icon.... Charlie Kirk did not stand for civility, compassion, or truth. There was nothing civil about him. * To memorialize him would be a grave mistake. In a November 4, 2025, email [] a self-described “faculty member” at UVU writes: I’ve had a hard time dealing with the aftermath of the shooting on our campus, and in particular, I cannot understand how people could support or mourn someone who was so divisive and spewed such vituperation in his “debates.” I regret that he was invited to UVU at all, and wish you had rethought the decision to allow him a forum on our campus. Also, there has been talk of a memorial to Charlie Kirk that will be placed on the UVU campus. The legislature seems determined to make it happen, and they have enormous power in Utah. I ask you to resist their desire to desecrate our campus with a memorial to such a divisive and hateful public figure. Please do not let it happen. It does not align with our brand of inclusiveness and welcoming. Should a memorial to him be erected on our campus, I fear you will lose many faculty members, including myself. I would not work at a university that supports Charlie Kirk's ideals in any way. The records reveal that just nine days after Kirk was assassinated, a person whose name is redacted was already proposing a $1 million fundraising [] effort called “Our Better Selves for a Better America.” I would like to raise $1 million for this proposal. I took the liberty of starting a draft. I'd like a very quick turnaround so I can fundraise quickly. I have one pledge for $100k. I would like to raise the other $900k quickly. UVU subsequently established “Our Better Selves for a Better America [ as a university-wide initiative focused on civil dialogue, disagreement, conflict resolution, and civic responsibility. The newly released records show that, behind the university’s public appeals for unity and free expression, some members of the UVU faculty were expressing a very negative attitude toward Kirk and his supporters. Charlie Kirk was assassinated while exercising his right to speak on a college campus. These records reveal that, even as Utah Valley University publicly called for free expression and civil discourse, some faculty members were making hateful and vicious comments about him, objecting to his invitation to campus, and threatening to leave if his memory were honored. We previously obtained records [] from Utah Valley University through this same records request detailing the university’s efforts to immediately pave over the site where Kirk was murdered. FBI RECORDS REVEAL THOMAS CROOKS BEHAVIOR BEFORE TRUMP SHOOTING Thomas Matthew Crooks, who attempted to assassinate Donald Trump at a July 2024 campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, purchased “a chest rig and ceramic plates,” and exhibited increasingly unusual behavior, including talking to himself, pacing at night, staying awake for extended periods and exhibiting impulsivity issues. We learned this from 180 pages [] [ heavily redacted Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) records we received through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit. Thomas would stay up all night dancing in [redacted]. Thomas seemed to have endless energy. * Thomas was never diagnosed with any mental health disorders as a child, but did have impulsivity issues. A July 15, 2024, FBI i [ report [] states that Crooks purchased firearms courses from Keystone Shooting Center online, including a basic carbine course beginning May 25, 2024, a basic handgun course beginning June 13, 2024, and an intermediate handgun course beginning June 22, 2024. The courses were purchased using the email address tmcrooks7@gmail.com. A July 25, 2024, FBI report [] states that Crooks was seen with two older men at a firearms store. The communication states: “Review of the web browser history of the device revealed the device accessed mailfence.com [] multiple times from 15 April 2024 to 8 July 2024.” In a July 15, 2024, electronic communication [], the FBI Counterterrorism unit requested assistance from a foreign government concerning information on the Samsung S136 device belonging to Crooks. A July 21, 2024, FBI report [] quotes a former Community College of Allegheny County laboratory classmate who said he “tried to get to know Crooks, told him jokes and invited him to go out.” According to the classmate, Crooks was “very self-isolated and kept to himself.” Crooks seemed to be very smart, and he clearly had the best grades in the class as he was teaching others. Around two weeks later, ICE removed Kharwin from its Alternatives to Detention (ATD) program and DHS allowed him to apply for asylum and work authorization and fly domestically. The Afghan national remained free in the United States for about a year until biometric and biographical information positively identified him on the terrorist watchlist and ICE Fugitive Operations arrested him in San Antonio, Texas. _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3149%2E259176%2EiqLfEg) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3149%2E259176%2EiqLfEg)_

On November 8th, 2022, after a difficult, expensive, and hard-fought reelection campaign, I called my opponent to offer my concession and congratulations.

It wasn't a pleasant call to make. But I've never second-guessed the decisions that led me there.

If we haven't met: I entered the Naval Academy at 17 and spent 20 years in the Navy as a nuclear engineer, my entire career aboard combatant ships.

In 2018, I ran for Congress and flipped Virginia's 2nd District.

I'm also a mom, which is still the best job I've ever had.

In Congress, I served on the January 6th Committee, knowing full well it could cost me my seat. That cycle, outside far-right groups spent $6,059,677 against me. Add a national environment that was brutal for frontline Democrats, and I came up short.

**For me, the worst outcome isn’t losing a fight. It’s going down with no fight at all.**

So I'm back, running to win this seat back from Jen Kiggans, because I can't sit on the sidelines and watch our country descend into chaos.

The Cook Political Report rates VA-02 a Toss-Up. This is one of Democrats’ best pickup opportunities in the country.

Republicans know it too. Jen Kiggans called Elon Musk's DOGE cuts "so necessary," even as they hit Hampton Roads hard. Musk's super PAC has started spending to keep her in office and beat me. Trump just spent $1.5M on ads against me in this district.

That's why September 30th matters. It's my last end-of-quarter FEC deadline before Election Day, and the report that follows is public. They have recruited their two most aggressive challengers to make sure that happens and they're pouring MILLIONS in because they see a path.In Michigan, it's Abdul El-Sayed. He is not a centrist. body:
I can’t wait for you to hear the stories Rev. Dr. Harold Middlebrook tells in this one.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a5bf9133b10c/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363884?e=dc5f639d62)

Hey friends,I'm thrilled to share with you episode 11 of the Standing Tall podcast! I can’t wait for you to hear the stories Rev. Dr. Harold Middlebrook tells in this one.[**[CLICK HERE to LISTEN NOW**]](https://us.list-manage.com/1CkOZwcYPwt?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
****

[**Listen or watch**](https://us.list-manage.com/fKiuhu4EAvp?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**now wherever you get your podcasts. 🎧**

I was honored to be able to sit down with Rev. Dr. Harold Middlebrook, a Memphis-born civil rights leader who worked directly with Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., organized voter registration drives across the South in the 1960s, and was present at the Lorraine Motel the day Dr. King was assassinated.

The Rev. Harold Middlebrook stands directly behind the Rev. Martin Luther King Jr. during the Memphis sanitation workers' strike in March 1968. Also pictured are the Rev. Jesse Jackson, upper right, and Dr. H. Ralph Jackson, left.

His life spans from a 10th-grade voter registration drive in Memphis to decades of ministry here in Knoxville, and in this conversation he draws some striking, sobering lines between what he fought for then and what we're facing again now.We get into the poll tax and how voter suppression actually worked, why local elections like school boards matter just as much as national ones, and his very direct case for why waiting until Election Day is a risk nobody needs to take.This one is a genuine piece of living history, and I hope it gives you as much perspective as it gave me.

**🗳️Yesterday was National Voter Registration Day!** If you're not registered, or you've moved and need to update your info, today's the day. It takes five minutes and it matters. **Head to**[**proudvoter.org**](https://us.list-manage.com/eyy6XpFHNIB?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**to check your status or get registered.** Rev. Middlebrook said it best in this episode: getting registered doesn't mean anything if you don't follow through and vote. _**So let's start with step one, today.**_

Thank you for being here,Gloria

name: Enoch for Congress
subject: I've heard "just one more chance" before
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer
body:
I spent years of my life as a counselor, sitting across from people trying to find the strength to walk away from someone who kept letting them down.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | Hello Peter,

This week the Vice President of the United States went on a podcast, looked back at the last two years, and made his closing argument to you in six words: _"Give us another chance."_
I want you to sit with that phrase for a second.
I spent years of my life as a counselor, sitting across from people trying to find the strength to walk away from someone who kept letting them down. And I know that phrase. It's the one you hear from the partner who breaks the promise, runs up the bill, disappears when you need them — and then shows up at your door asking you to give them _just one more chance._ Not because anything has changed. Because they need something from you.
That's the pitch now. After two years of rising costs and broken promises, their argument isn't "look at everything we delivered for you." It's "please don't leave us." When the people in charge are reduced to begging you for another chance, they're telling you the truth about their record without meaning to.
And when begging didn't feel like enough, the President reached for the other move: he tried to pay you.
At the Republican convention in Dallas, and again at a rally just this week, Donald Trump promised a $5,000 check to every American — but _only if Republicans win in November._ Let me put that as plainly as I can: the President is dangling a $5,000 payment in front of you in exchange for your vote. There's a word for offering people money to vote a certain way, and it is not "dividend."
Here's the part they're counting on you to forget.
This is not the first check they've promised. Remember the "DOGE dividend" — $5,000 a household, they said? It never came. Remember the $2,000 "tariff rebate" he promised over and over, all last year? It never came either. Every single time, there's a shiny new number and a brand-new promise, and every single time the check gets lost in the mail. By the count of outlets like _Forbes_ , this $5,000 offer is at least the _fourth_ time he's promised Americans a check like this — and not one of them has ever actually been paid.
Beg for another chance. Promise money that never arrives. Repeat. That's the whole strategy.
I'm not writing to make you angry, though I understand if you are. I'm writing because the families of Ohio's 8th District deserve so much better than a party that only remembers we exist when it needs our vote. We deserve leaders who _deliver_ instead of _dangle_ — who fight to bring down the cost of groceries and health care and housing because it's the right thing to do, not because there's an election in eight weeks.
You cannot buy that kind of representation. But you can build it — together, right here.
And that's the honest truth about this campaign: we can't be bought, and we don't have a billionaire's war chest. What we have is each other. [A contribution today — **$25, $50, $100, or whatever you can spare** — is how we answer a $5,000 bribe that will never be sent with something they can't buy at any price: real people showing up for one another.](https://us.list-manage.com/nyzMMsD1yav?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
Will you chip in right now and stand with us?

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

You'll explore these relationships in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

And as you have likely seen, there are some striking similarities in these emails and the tactics they use:

On Saturday, the men who built the machine asked permission to slow it down. That is not the same as asking whether we should build it at all.
It is not every day that the three most powerful men in artificial intelligence share a headline, and rarer still when the headline reads like a confession. On Saturday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published an essay titled "We Must Pace the Frontier," calling on the industry to slow the development of its most powerful models. Within hours, Elon Musk endorsed the appeal, and Sam Altman reportedly told his OpenAI staff the company was open to slowing down alongside the other labs. For one news cycle, the rivals of the AI race stood in agreement. For the rest of us, it ought to prompt a harder question than the one they asked.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Enough of this neurosis
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/911remembrance-12854876?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend,
King Charles has warned of the "existential dangers" posed by AI. I suppose that makes a change from the time he warned that the "doomsday clock of climate change" was ticking toward midnight. Or from when he told us that genetically modified food risked "the biggest environmental disaster of all time." I do not like to criticize the King of my native country, but I am not sure it is wise for him to keep straying into public policy like this. To be fair, the King is not the only one warning of the dangers of AI. Similar warnings have come from inside the industry itself, from leading figures such as Dario Amodei and Sam Altman. Why, though, would people who have invested billions of dollars in cutting-edge AI want to invite government regulation of innovation in their own industry? Over the past few years, Western AI firms have poured vast sums of capital into building foundational AI technology from scratch. Alarmingly, there is evidence that a number of Chinese AI firms have been able to replicate much of what those companies built. The FBI has described this as "industrial-scale" copying of American intellectual property. Having failed to protect their advantage by technical means, the industry now wants the state to protect it for them. Remember how, a couple of decades ago, we all used Yahoo before Google came along? Imagine if Yahoo had been able to persuade the US government to restrict the development of search engines. What if Yahoo had warned of the risks of "irresponsible" search engines that would allow anyone to look up anything? Some people, they might have said, could even look up how to commit dastardly acts. Regulate it! Or remember when everyone had a BlackBerry, rather than an iPhone? What if BlackBerry had persuaded the US government to slow down the development of smartphones? Those touch-screen devices, they might have warned, would allow all sorts of unsavory social media. Best control it! When AI industry leaders urge the state to regulate their sector, I do not believe they are being altruistic. They are lobbying for a regulatory "moat" to protect their commercial position. If they really wanted to slow down, they could slow down. Among the commentariat, I cannot help noticing that some of the most alarmist voices on AI are the same people who told us Covid was going to kill us all. Cast your mind back to those days of hysteria. Millions of people in countries such as Britain were placed under effective house arrest, needing a reason even to leave their own homes. Transatlantic travel was suspended for months. Schools were shut. Businesses were closed. The real disease was not the virus. It was a form of neurosis: a hysterical overreaction that did far more lasting damage than the virus itself. In the 1970s, the doomers told us that nuclear winter would end humanity. In the 1980s it was acid rain. In the 1990s it was global warming, which during the noughties morphed into climate change. Then came Covid hysteria. Now it is AI. I have no doubt that there will be downsides to AI. Like the printing press, new technology can be put to good purposes and bad ones. The printing press allowed the Bible to be printed and read in many languages. The same technology allowed the publication of Mein Kampf. AI, too, will serve both good and evil. Human ingenuity will require further ingenuity to counter the evil. The risks of AI will need to be tackled — by AI. Just as bad ideas in print were countered by good ideas in print. I am sad to see the King adopt, yet again, such a doomster stance. Think of the history of the English-speaking peoples at times when there really was reason to lack confidence in the future. Think of Charles's forebear, King Alfred, in 878 AD, when Christian England seemed on the brink of extinction. Or in 1315, when there really was an environmental disaster: the crops failed and famine followed. Or imagine what it must have felt like to live in England in 1348, when the Black Death killed four in ten people. You want doomster? Imagine what they felt in November 1916, when the Battle of the Somme ended with some 420,000 British casualties. You want pessimism about the future? Imagine it is London in October 1940. Your city is being bombed to rubble and a Nazi army is massing for invasion. Except that instead of doom, a 14-year-old girl — Princess Elizabeth, the future Queen and Charles's mother — gave a radio address to the nation's children. She assured them that **"in the end all will be well; for God will care for us and give us victory and peace."** Contrast that quiet assertion of faith in the future with King Charles's endless undermining of it. It seems to me that the further we are from real danger, and the more materially assured we become, the more we produce leaders who indulge the ridiculous idea that we are on the brink. In the six years that I have lived in America, I have marveled at the optimism I see all around me, especially here in the South. Yes, everyone faces challenges. The future could go awry. Nothing in this world is certain. Fear and uncertainty are part of the human condition. But here there is an inner faith in the future: that "in the end all will be well." That is perhaps why more Americans, especially in the South, marry younger and have more children than Europeans — the ultimate vote of confidence in the future. The West needs leaders who give us confidence in the future. Leaders who convey the idea that, no matter how great the challenge, we will see it through. Leaders who love our culture, and love those who love it too. Yes, AI will require us to adapt — just as we once had to work out how to make trains and cars safer. But we need to stop this relentless doom-mongering. Enough of this Western neurosis.

Welcome to the Special Release of _**The Conforti Brief**_. As part of our interactive grassroots newsletter, this special edition is published on the 3rd Saturday of each month. ## The Conforti Brief
---
| | **Informing voters** on current events and how Niki plans to help them once in office.
---
| |
**Fueling the Crisis: How Democrat Tax Hikes Compound the Gas Price Surge
**.Illinois families and small businesses are facing yet another squeeze at the pump, with gas prices surging 21 cents this week. While global conflicts are driving up base fuel costs, the reality is that the Democrats' relentless high-tax agenda is making this cost-of-living crisis significantly worse for everyday residents. In our state, hardworking families are regularly burdened with higher tolls and higher taxes, which only compounds the financial pain when energy markets spike.
.Democrats—like incumbent Sean Casten—pursuing a high-tax agenda makes Illinois increasingly unaffordable. Every time gas and toll taxes increase, the cost of doing business skyrockets, forcing local entrepreneurs to shoulder heavier burdens instead of creating jobs and fostering thriving communities. From job loss to higher prices, everyday Americans are being forced to deplete their savings just to get by.
.In the U.S. House, Niki Conforti will fight to reverse this trend and bring down prices for the 6th District. She will work to cut burdensome regulations in the energy industry to push for "speed to power," making our energy more resilient and affordable. By opposing tax and fee hikes on Illinoisans and curbing the reckless spending in Washington, Niki will ensure that our local families and small businesses can finally get the financial relief they deserve.
Stay informed on this issue—[**read the full breakdown here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/nCreivJPYAo?e=25f4fa3311&c2id=7b058fb5598c3e136d157ed790328086)
---
|
---
|
---
| | **Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (DuPage County)**
.
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot: August 5th
* Early voting and vote-by-mail voting begins: September 24th
* Last day to request a vote-by-mail ballot: October 29th
* Last day for early voting: November 2nd
* General Election Day: November 3rd
.

**Key Dates for the 2026 General Election (Cook County)**
**.**
* First day to apply for a vote-by-mail ballot: August 5th
* First day to vote early in Chicago (Downtown Only): September 24th
* Last day for online voter registration: October 18th
* Early voting opens in all 50 city wards and suburban Cook County: October 19th
.
.

**Get out the vote:** whether you plan to vote by mail, early voting in person, or voting in person on election day, it’s important we get out the vote to defeat incumbent Sean Casten.

.
---
|
---
| |

**TODAY is the day!** We warmly invite you to participate and walk alongside Niki Conforti and our campaign team at the **Palos Park Autumn in the Park Festival Parade**! Come out to show your support for our "District-First" vision and join the community for this wonderful tradition.
.
* **Date:** Saturday, September 19, 2026 (TODAY)
* **Time:** The parade steps off at 1:00 PM.
* **Location/Route:** The parade kicks off at 83rd Avenue on 123rd Street in Palos Park and travels westbound to 90th Avenue ending near the festival grounds.
* **Post-Parade:** A lively festival will be running from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM on the Village Green (8901 W. 123rd St). The festival will feature food vendors, artisan vendors, kids activities, and live musical entertainment!
.
.

You are invited to join Niki Conforti and our campaign team at the upcoming **Worth Township Republican Organization meeting**! This event is a fantastic opportunity to hear Niki speak about our campaign's focus on economic affordability, community safety, and bringing a true "district-first" mentality to Washington. Come out to meet Niki and share your vision for the district with local leaders and neighbors.
.
* **Date:** Tuesday, September 29, 2026
* **Location:** Oak Lawn VFW (Johnson-Phelps VFW Post #5220), 9514 S. 52nd Ave., Oak Lawn, IL 60453
*

*

We would love to have you join our ranks for these special events! To get more details, please contact our team at [**info@conforti4congress.com**](mailto:info@conforti4congress.com?subject=Conforti%20Events&body=).
We hope to see you there!

body:
I did the math this morning...

Derek, I know it’s a Saturday, so I’ll be quick: [**With just 45 days until Election Day, and millions of Pennsylvania voters we still have to reach, we can't afford to let a day go by without making it count. So, will you chip in $15 today to help us make the most of every single one of them?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139508966/647622971/1105271474?refcode=email_091926_sixweekends&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxM2ViNjU5NS0yYWI0LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6Ts23Mwv_tnQt_MGXB6UYetpvNC59QL_1fpj8uMWIZ8=) | | [Chip in →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139508967/647622972/-2120664357?refcode=email_091926_sixweekends&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxM2ViNjU5NS0yYWI0LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6Ts23Mwv_tnQt_MGXB6UYetpvNC59QL_1fpj8uMWIZ8=)
---
I did that math this morning and had to sit with it for a second — because 45 days sounds like plenty of time right up until you break it down.
**Six more weekends.**
**A handful of events.**
**46,000 square miles of Commonwealth, from Erie to Philly, with millions of Pennsylvanians we still have to reach.**

body:
You can bet Mike Johnson and his team are going to be looking at the numbers we put up.
#
Peter —
Republicans are holding on to the House of Representatives by the skin of their teeth. Please, let us explain why that makes your support for VoteVets — at this exact moment — extremely important.
We’re allocating our final budgets as we speak. We’re deciding who we’re targeting, what we’re going to hit them with, and when we’re going to do it. Here’s what it comes down to:
With a majority of just one or two votes, we can put a TON of pressure on the members that have been carrying Trump’s water for the last two years. The people who voted to continue the Iran War, or for Trump’s SAVE Act to restrict voting, or to pass a trillion dollar tax cut for billionaires paid for by Medicaid and food stamps cuts.
The list of vulnerable Republicans is long. We have a ton of targets ahead of us. The GOP knows this, and they’re scared. Terrified, actually. And with the final FEC deadline of the year coming up on September 30th we can have them really shaking in their boots.
You see, after that deadline hits, we’re legally required to report our fundraising numbers to the public. You can bet Mike Johnson and his team are going to be looking at the numbers we put up, because that’s how much we’re going to be able to spend against his members in the home stretch.
If we put out a big number, they’re in trouble. If we don’t, we’re the ones in trouble. That’s why your support, right here, today, is so important.
[**We want them scared. And we’re humbly asking you to make a donation of $5 or anything you can afford to VoteVets to help make that happen.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep26.f1bOKp&refcode=em260919-1-180&t=1&akid=35594%2E3013755%2Esiptc4)

Fellow Patriot,

We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let me explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.

It's Eileen Laubacher, the Democrat and retired U.S. Navy Rear Admiral running against Lauren Boebert here in Colorado.
I was 17-years-old the first time I raised my right hand and took an oath to support and defend the Constitution against all enemies, foreign and domestic.
I took those words, and that responsibility, seriously every day for the next 4 decades. When I was an intelligence officer. When I was deployed to Afghanistan. When I became an Admiral. And as a member of the president’s National Security Council.
But in all those years, I have never felt as much of a threat to our country, our Constitution, and our very democracy as I do right now. I said I would never run for office. But in this moment, I feel an obligation to step up, serve my community, and defend our country once again.
I am running for Congress to defeat Lauren Boebert because when she was sworn into office, Lauren took a similar oath to defend our Constitution – and she has betrayed it almost every single day since then.
Adam Frisch only lost to Lauren Boebert by 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. We can finally put an end to Lauren Boebert’s embarrassing political career – but I need your help now to do it.
Our campaign needs to raise another $100,000 before our deadline at midnight to defeat Lauren Boebert and take back the House for Democrats, but right now, we’re still short.
